notes.title: Demo Now Live! | Meet Your New Work & Study Buddies!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Fish Bosses![/p][p]Welcome to your personal desktop oasis! We're thrilled to announce that the new demo for Idlequarium is officially live! We've added a whole new school of exotic fish, ready to bring a splash of life and color to your screen.

[/p][h2]Here's a peek at what's waiting for you:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Your Personal Desktop Companion:[/b] Watch your charming fish swim freely across your screen, bringing a bit of calm and company to your work or study sessions.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]A Huge Variety of Fish:[/b] From the Clown Knifefish to the dazzling Discus, hundreds of exotic and precious fish are waiting to be discovered and added to your collection![/p][p] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Total Creative Freedom:[/b] With nearly 100 decorations and 6 distinct tanks, you have the power to design a truly unique underwater paradise. Your style, your rules![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Be The Reel BossFish:[/b] Master the art of fishkeeping by buying and selling your mature fish. Use your earnings to upgrade your gear and grow your aquatic empire![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]A Soothing, Stress-Free Vibe:[/b] Let the gentle sway of your fish and the soft sound of bubbles melt your stress away. This is your personal slice of tranquility.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]🐠Be the Fish Boss.
